largeImageRegression.scope: Existing genuine native 50 MP import/WASM-edit/save/reopen/full PNG decode, SVG native embedded PNG decode and native SVG mask crop/seam regressions pass. No new full 50 MP composite SVG raster/heap gate is claimed.

designAndLimits: Live text exports as editable SVG text lines (including complete masked/off-canvas line content), with exact authored newline positions, typography/family references, direction and physical alignment under the shared affine/mask/style hierarchy. Tabs/CR/form feed normalize to spaces like native Canvas fillText.

Native per-line top/alphabetic ascent differences determine baselines. Preparation uses one released 1x1 canvas and bounded cooperative line batches; individual native measurements cannot be preempted.

Registered referenced-family identity/status/descriptors are pinned across preparation and final encoding, including family lists/CSS escapes. Pending fonts, related changes, invalid settings and cancellation reject without partial output. Unrelated faces remain valid; later independent host edits keep history and do not rewrite captured output.

Missing native Canvas letterSpacing support is captured once, before any property assignment. A real Chromium prototype-absence emulation previously produced 0/8 spacing across two layers; the final regression emits 0/0 and matches native decoded PNG pixels exactly. This is API-absence emulation, not an actual old-browser/device acceptance result.

Font files are referenced, not copied/embedded. A real page-only loaded font fixture produces different decoded SVG/PNG pixels because the SVG image decoder substitutes its fallback; the report explicitly explains portability limits. Missing names can fall back and are not proof of availability.

Transformed system-font glyphs show real Canvas/SVG rasterization/hinting differences. Independent CTMs, advances, integrated area/centroids, no solid holes and one-pixel silhouette support constrain geometry; maximum edge-byte differences are recorded rather than claimed as byte parity.

Initial affine byte-parity assertions failed, prompting independent geometry/coverage diagnostics. Initial binary-font pending fixture was already loaded; it was replaced with a genuinely stalled local browser font request whose status is verified as loading. Raw initial/corrected logs remain separately hashed.

No new constructor/mutation API, schema/project/workspace version, REST render/browser-sync route, plugin grant, script file/font-byte/enumeration privilege, source-byte mutation, paid operation or cloud upload.
No arbitrary image cap, full-document text rasterization, font packaging or glyph outlining. Individual timings do not establish input-to-photon/p95/long-task/heap/device-wide performance.
SVG paint/adjustment/smart contents, Blend If, general SVG import/round-trip, richer type/layout/font packaging and the complete broader roadmap remain open.
